subcategory_description: Tax that employers pay on benefits and deductions for their staff.
label: Single rate of fringe benefit tax
context: An employer can use this rate in quarterly, income year and annual returns. It applies to all benefits provided, however much the employees earn.

label: Alternate rate of fringe benefit tax
context: An employer can use this rate in quarterly returns, in quarters 1 to 3 only. The single rate must be used if the alternate rate is not.

label: Income plus benefits under which the alternate rate suits
context: The alternate rate may suit an employer when an employee's income and fringe benefits together are less than this amount for the tax year.

label: Limit per employee, quarterly return
context: Unclassified benefits and gift cards: if the taxable value for an employee in a quarter is more than this, FBT applies to the full amount. At or below it, no FBT is paid.

label: Limit per employee, income year or annual return
context: Unclassified benefits and gift cards: if the taxable value for an employee in the year is more than this, FBT applies to the full amount. At or below it, no FBT is paid.

label: Annual limit for all employees
context: Unclassified benefits and gift cards across all employees (including associated persons and companies in a group). If the total over a year, or the last 4 quarters, is more than this, FBT applies to the full amount.

label: Motor vehicle: cost price method, quarterly (GST inclusive)
context: The percentage of cost price used in the quarterly and annual return calculation for private use of a vehicle, GST inclusive. A different percentage applies GST exclusive.

label: Motor vehicle: cost price method, income year (GST inclusive)
context: The percentage of cost price used in the income year return calculation for private use of a vehicle, GST inclusive.

label: Motor vehicle: tax book value method, quarterly (GST inclusive)
context: The percentage of tax book value used in the quarterly and annual return calculation, GST inclusive, for a vehicle with no Investment Boost claimed.

label: Motor vehicle: tax book value method, income year (GST inclusive)
context: The percentage of tax book value used in the income year return calculation, GST inclusive, for a vehicle with no Investment Boost claimed.

label: Motor vehicle with Investment Boost: quarterly (GST inclusive)
context: The percentage of tax book value used in the quarterly and annual return calculation, GST inclusive, where the tax book value includes an Investment Boost reduction. It applies from 1 April 2026.

label: Motor vehicle with Investment Boost: income year (GST inclusive)
context: The percentage of tax book value used in the income year return calculation, GST inclusive, where the tax book value includes an Investment Boost reduction. It applies from 1 April 2026.

label: Minimum tax book value for a vehicle
context: When a vehicle's tax book value falls below this amount, this minimum is used, because the employee still has an ongoing private use benefit.

label: Minimum tax book value, Investment Boost vehicle
context: The minimum tax book value for a vehicle on which Investment Boost has been claimed. It applies from 1 April 2026.

label: Prescribed interest rate, 1 October to 31 December 2026
context: The rate used to work out the fringe benefit value of low-interest loans to employees for this quarter. Inland Revenue reviews it quarterly.

label: Prescribed interest rate from 1 January 2027
context: The rate that applies to low-interest loans to employees from 1 January 2027.
